title: ArXiv: frb100-40 After Two Decades: An Optimality Certificate and a Preregistered Search Study
description: Abstract: For more than 20 years, the Model-RB benchmark frb100-40 remained an open challenge; since 2014, its public record had stood at 99 of 100 variables. We give a directly checkable 100-vertex independent...

ko.title: 20년 만의 해결: Model-RB 벤치마크 frb100-40의 최적성 증명서와 사전등록 연구
ko.hook: 20년 동안 미해결 난제로 남았던 벤치마크 문제의 최적해 증명 과정을 확인하세요.

en.title: frb100-40 After Two Decades: An Optimality Certificate and Preregistered Search Study
en.hook: Discover how a 20-year-old open benchmark challenge was finally solved with a checkable optimality certificate.
key_takeaways: Solves the 20-year-old Model-RB benchmark frb100-40 challenge
Provides a directly checkable 100-vertex independent set
Marks a significant milestone in optimization and algorithm research

zh.title: 二十年后的突破：frb100-40的最优性证明与预注册搜索研究
zh.hook: 见证困扰学界20年的Model-RB基准测试难题如何被直接可验证的最优性证书所破解。
key_takeaways: 破解了长达20年未解的frb100-40基准测试难题
提供了可直接检查的100顶点独立集
为算法和最优化研究带来了重要的里程碑突破
